verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question to ask of an AI research SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or any privacy controls. The pack covers only search, library, API/MCP and pricing features. The Anonymous Tier of the MCP server is a trial-access tier, not a tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
